Hi Marta,

Thank you for contacting us. When you place an order, we authorize the full amount, and the charge settles when the order ships. It's common to see both a pending authorization and a settled charge appear for a day or two, which can look like a double charge—the pending authorization automatically drops off within five business days.

However, if you believe this is a genuine duplicate charge that doesn't match an order in your account, please reply with the charge amount and date, and a specialist will investigate and follow up with you.

Best regards,
Fernwood Outfitters Support

Hi Jonas,

You can download an invoice for your order from the Orders page in your account. Invoices are also emailed to you when your order ships. This should provide the itemized documentation your company needs for reimbursement.

If you have any trouble locating the invoice or need further assistance, a specialist will follow up with you.

Best regards,
Fernwood Outfitters Support

Hi Amelia,

I'm sorry you're having trouble accessing your account. Unfortunately, the article I have available doesn't cover login issues. A specialist from our team will follow up with you shortly to help resolve this.

Thank you for your patience!

Fernwood Outfitters Support

Hi Ravi,

Thanks for reaching out. I understand you're having trouble accessing your account after replacing your phone and losing your authenticator app.

Our article on account management doesn't cover this situation, so a specialist will follow up with you shortly to help restore your access.

We appreciate your patience!

Fernwood Outfitters Support

Hi Lucía,

Thank you for reaching out. I understand your frustration with the delay on order 49087.

To help you best, I'd recommend checking the Orders page of your account for the most current tracking information. If a tracking number is available, the carrier's tracking page will have the latest updates on your package's location.

Given that it's been eleven days, a specialist will follow up with you shortly to investigate your order further and determine next steps.

Thank you for your patience.

Fernwood Outfitters Support

Hi Owen,

Thanks for reaching out! I can see you're interested in delivery timing for the Ridge Shell with expedited shipping to Vancouver.

To give you accurate delivery details, I'll need a specialist to follow up with you. They can provide specific estimated arrival dates based on current shipping times to your area and the faster shipping option you're considering.

In the meantime, you can track any order from your account's Orders page once it ships—you'll receive a carrier name and tracking number.

Best regards,
Fernwood Outfitters Support

Hi Hana,

Thank you for contacting us about receiving the wrong item. I'm sorry to hear you didn't get what you ordered. A specialist will follow up with you shortly to help resolve this issue and get you the correct women's medium fleece.

Please have your order number ready for our team.

Best regards,
Fernwood Outfitters Support

Hi Karim,

Thank you for contacting us. I understand your frustration. According to our policy, refunds to the original payment method are issued within five business days of arrival at our warehouse, and your bank may take an additional three to ten business days to process the credit.

Since more than 15 business days have passed since delivery to us with no refund appearing, a specialist will follow up with you shortly to investigate. Please have your order number ready.

Best regards,
Fernwood Outfitters Support

Hi Beatriz,

Thank you for contacting us about your tent pole issue. I'm sorry to hear about the damage to your Summit 2 tent.

Unfortunately, the article I have access to covers care for shells, down jackets, and sleeping bags—not tent poles or repairs. A specialist will follow up with you shortly to discuss your situation and help find a resolution.

We appreciate your business!

Fernwood Outfitters Support

Hi Felix,

Thanks for reaching out. When shells stop repelling water, it's often because the waterproof coating has worn down with use. We recommend washing your shell first, then applying a spray-on re-proofing treatment to restore the coating. This should help water bead again without affecting your warranty.

If the issue persists after re-proofing, a specialist will follow up with you to investigate further.

Fernwood Outfitters Support

Hi Sarah,

Thank you for your interest in sending a gift to your family member! Unfortunately, the information I have available doesn't address shipping to APO addresses. A specialist will follow up with you soon to help answer your question and explore your options.

Best regards,
Fernwood Outfitters Support

Hi Chiara,

Thank you for contacting us about the discount code issue. Unfortunately, the article I have access to doesn't cover discount codes or how they're applied to orders.

A specialist will follow up with you shortly to investigate why the code didn't work and discuss your options.

Best regards,
Fernwood Outfitters Support

Hi Mohammed,

Great news! We can definitely help with that. We're able to merge your two accounts so all your orders and rewards points appear in one place.

To get started, please reply with the email addresses for both accounts and let us know which one you'd like to keep. The merge takes one business day.

Thanks for reaching out!

Fernwood Outfitters Support

Hi Grace,

Thank you for reaching out. Since you placed your order yesterday, a specialist will follow up with you about updating your delivery address. They'll be able to assist you directly with your specific situation.

In the meantime, you can check your order status on the Orders page of your account.

Best regards,
Fernwood Outfitters Support

Hi Pablo,

Don't worry—your jacket likely isn't ruined! Down jackets need special care to maintain their loft. When washing, use a gentle cycle with technical-fabric wash (never regular detergent) and tumble dry on low. The key step is adding two or three clean tennis balls to the dryer; they help restore the loft and break up clumping during drying.

If your jacket still seems flat after a proper dry cycle with tennis balls, a specialist will follow up with you to discuss next steps.

Best regards,
Fernwood Outfitters Support

Hi Yasmin,

Great question! You can return individual items from your order. Since you're initiating a refund rather than an exchange, there is a $7 label fee that will be deducted from your refund—unless the item arrived damaged or we sent you the wrong item.

To get started, visit your Orders page and select the item you'd like to return. Make sure it's unworn with tags attached, and you'll be within our 60-day return window.

A specialist will follow up if you need additional assistance with your partial return.

Best regards,
Fernwood Outfitters Support

Hi Tom,

Thank you for contacting us. When an order is placed, we authorize the full amount on your card. Even after cancellation, a pending authorization can remain visible for a day or two before dropping off automatically—this typically happens within five business days.

If the pending charge doesn't clear within that timeframe, please reach out with your order details and the charge amount/date, and a specialist will investigate further.

Best regards,
Fernwood Outfitters Support

Hi Aiko,

Thank you for reaching out about your store credit expiration. The article I have available doesn't include information about store credit expiry dates. A specialist will follow up with you to answer this question and locate any relevant details about your account.

We appreciate your patience!

Fernwood Outfitters Support

Hi Ben,

Thanks for reaching out about your trekking pole. Unfortunately, the article I have access to only covers care for technical shells, down jackets, and sleeping bags—not trekking poles or their components.

A specialist will follow up with you shortly to discuss your carbide tip issue and help find the best solution.

Best regards,
Fernwood Outfitters Support
